description: This is a unit test file for the ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It contains test cases for CRUD operations and validation rules related to reporting methods in the HRM system.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the functionalities of the ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI, including CRUD operations and validation logic.

methods.name: getReportingMethodService
methods.description: Retrieves the ReportingMethodConfigurationService instance used in tests.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single reporting method by ID, asserting the correctness of the returned data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies the validation rules for retrieving a single reporting method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of reporting methods, ensuring the correct methods are called and the response is as expected.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for deleting reporting methods.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a reporting method and checks the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for updating a reporting method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new reporting method and its proper response.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for creating a reporting method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of reporting methods, including total count and individual entries.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for fetching all reporting methods.
